description: Turns an old HC campaign of this site into a new webinar: it copies the content, keeps the host's own providers and cleans the payload. Side effect: it creates a new campaign that cannot be un-created, and with mode replace_url it also redirects every old page address and deletes the old HC campaign afterwards, which cannot be undone. Needs `session_id`, `source_id` (the old campaign on this site), `mode` and a clear yes (`confirm` true); a campaign that is already a WebinarIgnition campaign is refused with source_not_hc. The modes: replace_url redirects the old addresses and removes the old campaign, keep_both leaves it in place, adopt_pages copies its pages onto the new one. Say which mode and what happens to the old campaign before you write. A second run on the same source creates nothing and answers already_imported; use `force` only when the host explicitly wants a second copy. For a WebinarIgnition export payload use wi_import_webinar instead, and read the result with wi_get_webinar.

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said which mode and that the old campaign may be removed.

force.description: true creates a second, deliberate copy although this source was already imported.

language.description: The participant-facing language for the new campaign, e.g. de_DE. Defaults to the source.

mode.description: replace_url redirects the old addresses and removes the old campaign, keep_both keeps it, adopt_pages copies its pages.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

source_id.description: The old HC campaign id on this site.

title.description: A title for the new campaign. Leave it out to take the source title.

type.description: Override the format. Leave it out to keep the source's.

name: wi_import_legacy_webinar
title: Take over an old HC webinar
